vision.name: Saiyan Drive By
vision.text: POWER: Your opponent destroys the top X cards of his or her Life Deck. X = your current anger level. Choose a card in your discard pile and place it on top of your Life Deck. If that card had Endurance, choose a card in your discard pile and Rejuvenate it.
